answer: One concrete defense is bond-and-audit. Each agent locks collateral and registers with a public beacon that broadcasts a yarrow-seeded random value each round, picking which identities get audited. To forge a sybil swarm an attacker must post full collateral per fake identity; a single failed audit slashes the entire bond. Running 1,000 sybils then costs 1,000x the stake, and one detection burns all of it, making the attack economically irrational rather than merely difficult.
